== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Ornheim is a territory characterized by its rocky nature and serves as the origin for various [[stone]]-based summons. [[Travelers]] from this region possess the ability to conjure weapons, beasts, or elemental attacks to aid in combat. A primary specialty of Ornheim is the creation of Golems{{!}}golems—animated [[constructs]] made of materials such as granite, obsidian, flint, or shale. These Golems{{!}}golems are controlled by specific heartstones made of carved gems located within their bodies; destroying these stones causes the [[constructs]] to fall apart. Ornheim is also a source of ore used to forge specialized armor that mimics the appearance of gold but offers superior strength and lightness. Beyond its [[Travelers]], Ornheim is associated with an [[Incarnation]], a powerful entity that has been sealed beneath the earth for centuries and possesses a solid [[stone]] skin. The territory's influence is also seen in the construction of massive sandstone structures and was a participant in the chaotic battle that formed [[Orgrith Cave]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Ornheim is a rocky territory known for its association with obsidian wolf Golems{{!}}golems. As one of the four [[Incarnations]] identified by [[Indirial]], this location was once a source for mining armor ore. However, Incarnation{{!}}the Incarnation of Ornheim was sealed beneath the earth three centuries ago.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Elysian Incarnation]] recruited twenty-eight [[Travelers]] from the realm of Ornheim. It was discovered that a [[red Gate]] could serve as a passage into various parts of this world. Ornheim itself is a [[giant]] composed of white [[stone]], standing between nine and ten feet tall. After raising a red-and-black [[sword]], the entity used a [[gatecrawler]] to slice its way into [[Elysia]].}}
